units.source_text: 这一天早上，小野草庵里收到了僧都的来信，

en.t: That morning, a letter from the Sozu arrived at the small hermitage in Ono,

units.source_text: 信中说道：“薰大将的使者小君，昨夜想已到你处来访过了？

en.t: and it said, "Kogimi, General Kaoru's messenger, must have come to visit you last night, did he not?

units.source_text: 请你告诉小姐：‘薰大将向我探问小姐情状。

en.t: Please tell the young lady: 'General Kaoru asked me about your condition.

units.source_text: 我给小姐授戒，本是无上功德，如今反而弄得乏味，使我不胜惶恐。’

en.t: Giving you the precepts should have been an act of supreme merit, yet now it has come to seem futile, and I am deeply troubled.'

units.source_text: 我自己欲说之事甚多，且待过了今明两日，再行走访面谈。”

en.t: I myself have many things to say, but after today and tomorrow have passed, I will visit and speak with you in person."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧不知这是什么事情，甚是吃惊，便来到浮舟房中，把这信给她看。

en.t: The younger nun had no idea what this was about and was greatly startled, so she went to Ukifune's room and showed her the letter.

units.source_text: 浮舟看了，脸红起来。

en.t: When Ukifune read it, her face flushed.

units.source_text: 想起世人已经知道她的下落，不胜痛苦。

en.t: Thinking that people in the world already knew where she was, she was overwhelmed with pain.

units.source_text: 又念一向隐瞒，这妹尼僧定然怀恨，只得默默不答。

en.t: She also thought that, since she had kept it hidden all along, the younger nun must surely resent her, and she could only remain silent without answering.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧满怀怨恨地对她说道：“你还是把实情告诉我吧。

en.t: The younger nun said to her with deep resentment, "Please tell me the truth after all.

units.source_text: 如此隐瞒我，叫我好痛苦啊！”

en.t: It hurts me terribly to have you hide things from me like this!"

units.source_text: 她因不知实情，慌得手足无措。

en.t: Because she did not know the truth, she was so flustered that she did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 正在此时，小君来了，

en.t: Just then, Kogimi arrived,

units.source_text: 叫人传言：“我是从山上来的，带有僧都信件在此。”

en.t: and had someone announce, "I have come from the mountain and have a letter from the Sozu here."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧想：怎么僧都又有信来？

en.t: The younger nun wondered why another letter had come from the Sozu.

units.source_text: 颇觉奇怪，说道：“看了这封信，想必可以知道实情了。”

en.t: Finding it very strange, she said, "Once we read this letter, surely we will know the truth."

units.source_text: 便叫人传言：“请到这里来。”

en.t: So she had someone say, "Please come in here."

units.source_text: 但见一个眉清目秀、举止端详的童子，穿着一身漂亮的衣服，缓步而入。

en.t: Then a boy with clear, handsome features and composed manners, dressed in beautiful clothes, walked slowly in.

units.source_text: 里面送出一个圆坐垫去，

en.t: From inside, someone sent out a round cushion,

units.source_text: 小君就在帘子旁边跪下，

en.t: and Kogimi knelt beside the curtain,

units.source_text: 说道：“僧都吩咐，不要叫人传言。”

en.t: saying, "The Sozu instructed me not to pass the message through others."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧便亲自出来应对。

en.t: The younger nun therefore came out in person to respond.

units.source_text: 小君将信呈上，

en.t: Kogimi presented the letter,

units.source_text: 妹尼僧一看，

en.t: and when the younger nun looked at it,

units.source_text: 封面上写着：“修道女公子台升——自山中寄。”

en.t: the cover read, "To the noble young lady on the religious path, sent from the mountains."

units.source_text: 下面署着僧都姓名。

en.t: Below it was signed with the Sozu's name.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧把信交与浮舟。

en.t: The younger nun handed the letter to Ukifune.

units.source_text: 浮舟无法否认，但觉狼狈不堪，越发退入内室，不肯和人见面了。

en.t: Ukifune could not deny it, but felt utterly embarrassed and withdrew even farther into the inner room, refusing to see anyone.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧对她说道：“你平日原是不苟言笑的，

en.t: The younger nun said to her, "You have never been one to smile or laugh easily,

units.source_text: 但今天如此愁闷，实在使我伤心！”

en.t: but seeing you so gloomy today truly saddens me!"

units.source_text: 便把僧都来信拆开来看，

en.t: Then she opened the letter from the Sozu and read it,

units.source_text: 但见信中写道：“今天薰大将来此，探问小姐情况，

en.t: and found that it said, "Today General Kaoru came here and asked about the young lady's situation.

units.source_text: 贫僧已将实情从头至尾详细奉告。

en.t: This humble monk has explained the truth to him in detail from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 据大将说：背弃深恩重爱，而侧身于田舍人之中，

en.t: According to the General, to turn away from profound kindness and deep love and place oneself among country people

units.source_text: 出家为尼，反将深受诸佛谴责。

en.t: will bring severe reproach from all the Buddhas, even if one leaves the world and becomes a nun.

units.source_text: 贫僧闻之不胜惶恐，然而无可如何。

en.t: Hearing this, this humble monk was deeply alarmed, yet there was nothing I could do.

units.source_text: 还请不背前盟，重归旧好，借以消减迷恋之罪。

en.t: Please do not betray your former pledge, but return to your old bond, thereby lessening the sin of deluded attachment.

units.source_text: 一日出家，功德无量。

en.t: Even one day of renunciation brings immeasurable merit.

units.source_text: 故即使还俗，亦非徒劳，出家之功德仍属有效也。

en.t: Therefore, even if you return to secular life, it will not have been in vain; the merit of renunciation will still remain valid.

units.source_text: 其余详情，且待他日面谈。

en.t: As for the remaining details, let us discuss them in person another day.

units.source_text: 此小君想必另有言语奉告。”

en.t: This Kogimi will surely have other words to convey to you."

units.source_text: 这信中已经分明说出浮舟对薰大将的关系了，

en.t: This letter had already stated clearly Ukifune's connection with General Kaoru,

units.source_text: 但外人全然不晓。

en.t: but outsiders knew absolutely nothing about it.
